'''Ryan Melton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Buford tournament]] on 4 August 2001 with EBO, according to Zafar Tejani's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001d2814/ z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001], DeckTech (Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-z-goes-to-gq-buford-aug-4th-2001d2814/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
